About HighLevel:
HighLevel is an AI-powered business operating system that gives agencies, entrepreneurs and SMBs the infrastructure to build, automate and scale. Today, HighLevel supports SMBs across 150+ countries, fueling community-driven growth rooted in real customer outcomes.
To date, businesses operating on HighLevel have generated over $7 billion in ecosystem value, demonstrating the impact of shared infrastructure at scale. By centralizing conversations, automation and intelligence into one system, we help businesses move faster, reduce complexity and execute efficiently.
Behind the platform, HighLevel powers more than 4 billion API hits and 2.5 billion message events daily. With 250 terabytes of distributed data, 250+ microservices and over 1 million domain names supported, our architecture is built for performance, resilience and long-term scalability.

Our People
With over 2,000 team members across 10+ countries, HighLevel operates as a global, remote-first organization built for speed and ownership. We value initiative, clarity and execution, creating space for ambitious people to build systems that support millions of businesses worldwide. Here, innovation thrives, ideas are celebrated and people come first, no matter where they call home.

Our Impact
Every month, HighLevel enables more than 1.5 billion messages, 200 million leads and 20 million conversations for the more than 1 million businesses we support. Behind those numbers are real people building independence, expanding opportunity and creating measurable impact. We’re proud to be a part of that.
Learn more about us on our YouTube Channel or Blog Posts.
About the Role:
We are seeking an entrepreneurial and technically strong Director of Engineering - Marketplace to own and scale HighLevel's Marketplace and Developer Ecosystem.

This is not a traditional engineering leadership role. You will own the entire product lifecycle - strategy, product management, design, engineering, quality, delivery, and operations, with direct accountability for business outcomes.

You will lead our API Governance, App Marketplace, Developer Platform, Monetization, and Integrations portfolio while building a high-performing organization of Full Stack Builders (FSBs) - autonomous, AI-native engineers capable of taking products from idea to production with minimal dependencies.

You will operate with the mindset of a product founder, combining deep technical expertise, customer obsession, business ownership, and organizational leadership.
Key Responsibilities:
1. End-to-End Product & Business Ownership

Own product vision, strategy, roadmap, prioritization, and execution across the Marketplace ecosystem.

Drive measurable business outcomes, including developer adoption, marketplace revenue, app growth, customer experience, and platform reliability.

Own product discovery, UX/design, engineering, QA, releases, and post-launch performance, ensuring accountability from idea to impact.

Make strategic decisions on product investments, resource allocation, and trade-offs between growth, quality, speed, and scalability.

2. Build & Scale an FSB Organization

Build and lead an organization of Full Stack Builders capable of independently designing, building, testing, shipping, and operating complete product experiences.

Hire, mentor, and develop entrepreneurial engineers and engineering leaders with strong product instincts, technical depth, and business acumen.

Champion AI-native development practices, leveraging AI tools, agents, and automation to accelerate product development and quality.

Establish a culture of high ownership, rapid experimentation, continuous delivery, and minimal organizational handoffs.

3. Marketplace & Platform Leadership

Own the evolution of Public APIs, developer tooling, SDKs, App Marketplace, App Studio, monetization infrastructure, and marketplace extensibility.

Scale marketplace payments, subscriptions, usage-based billing, rebilling, and payouts with high financial accuracy and reliability.

Ensure security, architectural scalability, API governance, developer experience, and operational excellence across the platform.

4. Strategic Execution & Organizational Accountability

Translate company objectives and customer insights into product strategies with measurable business impact.

Establish clear ownership, success metrics, quality standards, and accountability across the organization.

Drive fast, iterative product development without compromising customer experience, security, or reliability.

Partner with company leadership on ecosystem growth, commercial opportunities, and long-term platform investments.
Requirements:
10+ years of engineering experience, including 5+ years in engineering leadership, with experience leading multiple teams or engineering managers.

Proven experience owning products end-to-end, including product strategy, technical architecture, execution, and business outcomes.

Demonstrated ability to build high-performing, autonomous teams and develop strong engineering leaders.

Background in SaaS platforms, Public APIs, Developer Ecosystems, Marketplaces, or Integration Platforms preferred

Deep technical expertise in distributed systems, API architecture, security, and scalable cloud infrastructure.

Strong product thinking, UX sensibility, customer empathy, and commercial judgment.

Hands-on experience with modern development stacks, preferably Node.js and Vue.js (or React/Angular).

Experience leveraging AI-assisted engineering workflows and automation to improve development velocity.

Entrepreneurial mindset, strong ownership, and the ability to operate effectively in ambiguous, fast-moving environments.
EEO Statement:
